sources.title: Latest issuer results independently verified by lead
sources.supports: Lead independently opened the issuer-distributed H1 2026 release on 12 September 2026. Sales CHF43.109bn and underlying trading operating profit CHF7.081bn are corroborated. Earlier retrieval failure of the corporate URL is historical, not a remaining financial-metric gap. The AI deployment source remains unavailable; no controlled AI or retained-cash claim is accepted. The half-year screen is not comparable with an annual benefit illustration.

financial_anchor.metric: H1 2026 sales and underlying trading operating profit
financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: Nestlé describes AI in R&D, consumer and factory workflows, but no retrieved source establishes representative quality-adjusted incremental cash.
ai_claim.stage: E1 capability; no opened AI deployment evidence
ai_claim.scope: Specific workflow only; infrastructure demand is separated from own productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: No representative controlled cohort or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: infant-formula recall and water/portfolio issues demonstrate that data/automation cannot substitute for supplier controls, validation and governance.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: CHF354.05m = 5% of H1 2026 underlying trading operating profit of CHF7.081bn. This is a six-month, pre-tax non-GAAP screen and is NOT_COMPARABLE with the annual benefit illustration; no annualization is assumed.

arithmetic.inputs: pool CHF18bn eligible manufacturing, supply-chain, marketing-production and administrative cost; efficiency 8%; realization 40%; retained share 50%; recurring cost CHF200m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense
